query:
WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS (
                SELECT id, parent_id, 1 AS depth
                FROM menu_sections
                WHERE id = $1
                UNION ALL
                SELECT a.id, ms.parent_id, a.depth + 1
                FROM ancestors a
                JOIN menu_sections ms ON a.parent_id = ms.id
            )
            SELECT MAX(depth) as "depth!"
            FROM ancestors
